entries.title: Psalms 139:1
segments: To the Chief Musician, A Psalm of David. O LORD, You have searched me and have known [me].

entries.title: Psalms 139:2
segments: You know my sitting down and my rising up; You understand my thought afar off.

entries.title: Psalms 139:3
segments: You search my path and my lying down, and are acquainted [with] all my ways.

entries.title: Psalms 139:4
segments: For [there is] not a word in my tongue, but, lo, O LORD, You know it altogether.

entries.title: Psalms 139:5
segments: You have closed me in behind and in front, and laid Your hand on me.

entries.title: Psalms 139:6
segments: Such knowledge [is] too wonderful for me; it is high, I cannot go up to it.

entries.title: Psalms 139:7
segments: Where shall I go from Your Spirit? Or where shall I flee from Your presence?

entries.title: Psalms 139:8
segments: If I go up into Heaven, You are there; if I make my bed in Sheol, behold, You [are there].

entries.title: Psalms 139:9
segments: [If] I take the wings of the morning [and] dwell in the furthest parts of the sea;

entries.title: Psalms 139:10
segments: even there shall Your hand lead me, and Your right hand shall hold me.

entries.title: Psalms 139:11
segments: If I say, Surely the darkness shall cover me, even the night [shall be] light around me.

entries.title: Psalms 139:12
segments: Yea, the darkness does not hide from You; but the night shines as the day; as [is] the darkness, so is the light to You.

entries.title: Psalms 139:13
segments: For You have possessed my inward parts; You have covered me in my mother's womb.

entries.title: Psalms 139:14
segments: I will praise You; for I am fearfully [and] wonderfully made; Your works [are] marvelous and my soul knows [it] very well.

entries.title: Psalms 139:15
segments: My bones were not hidden from You when I was made in secret [and] skillfully formed in the lowest parts of the earth.

entries.title: Psalms 139:16
segments: Your eyes saw my embryo; and in Your book all [my members] were written, the days they were formed, and not one [was] among them.

entries.title: Psalms 139:17
segments: How precious also are Your thoughts to me, O God! How great is the sum of them!

entries.title: Psalms 139:18
segments: [If] I should count them, they are more than the sand; when I awake, I am still with You.

entries.title: Psalms 139:19
segments: Surely You will slay the wicked, O God; and bloody men, depart from me.

entries.title: Psalms 139:20
segments: Who will speak against You maliciously? Your enemies are lifted up with vanity.

entries.title: Psalms 139:21
segments: O LORD, do I not hate those who hate You? And am I [not] grieved with those who rise up against You?

entries.title: Psalms 139:22
segments: I hate them [with] perfect hatred; I count them my enemies.

entries.title: Psalms 139:23
segments: Search me, O God, and know my heart; try me, and know my thoughts,

entries.title: Psalms 139:24
segments: and see if [any] wicked way [is] in me; and lead me in the way everlasting.
